notes.title: Love Finds a Way Sale
notes.content:
To celebrate Valentine's this year, We decided to have a 50% discount sale for Raptor Boyfriend: A High School Romance and Psychroma!

In a time where marginalized people are struggling to find love and live authentically, representation is more important than ever. 

Rocket Adrift's games strive to give a voice to those who need someone to speak up for them. They also strive to tell stories and represent characters that are widely left out of mainstream media. That is why we felt it was a statement to show up fully as ourselves and fulfil our mission with the narratives of Raptor Boyfriend and Psychroma.

We hope with this sale, we can make our games more accessible for people who they will resonate with the most, while also keeping our small, diverse studio afloat.

Thank you for your time! Please share these games with people you think would enjoy them, and if you haven't yet, consider grabbing a copy for yourself.

- Rocket Adrift Team

notes.title: Soundtrack & Supporter Bundle Now Available!
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

We are excited to kick off 2025 with a brand new update - The Psychroma Soundtrack is now live!
The sonically resonant compilation was written, composed, and performed by our very own audio engineer and artist, Sloane Smith. 
Now Psychroma fans can enjoy all 23 tracks as standalone DLC, and for new players both the game and Soundtrack can be purchased together in our Support Bundle.

Thanks so much for everyone's support, and we hope you continue to enjoy our little game!
Until next time,

 - Rocket Adrift

notes.title: Psychroma Localization in 15 Languages!
notes.content:
We are super excited to officially release Psychroma in 15 new languages!

Languages included:
[list]
[*] Catalan
[*] Croatian
[*] Dutch
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Greek
[*] Hungarian
[*] Italian
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese (Brazilian)
[*] Portuguese (European)
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish (European)
[*] Spanish (Latin American)
[*] Thai
[*] Turkish
[/list]

Rocket Adrift has partnered with the volunteer-run queer translation initiative [url=https://queer-them-all.itch.io/]Queer Them All[/url] to bring Psychroma to new queer players across the world. 

Along with this exciting new update, we have also addressed some small bugs and ensured better Steam Deck compatibility.

Thanks so much to all of you that have wish listed and purchased Psychroma! We hope you will continue to enjoy our little game and recommend it to more players!

notes.title: Version 1.5.2 Patch
notes.content: A patch for the Demi mirror reflection taking away player inputs.

notes.title: Psychroma Update: The Definitive Edition
notes.content:
This is it, the definitive version. We’ve worked diligently to make the game accessible to more audiences because you have told us how much Psychroma’s story has meant to you.

[list]
[*] Improved Steam Deck Compatibility. Transcend “playable” with increased legibility on in-game text.

[*] Additional Art. New details and polish to immerse and unsettle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514319/8243ef3001df2d8e6e9f7ec0e36e4c569b454ce6.png[/img]

[*] Localization Support. New localization framework to support languages rolling out in the coming weeks.

[*] Brazilian Portuguese Language Support. Painstakingly provided by the PT-BR team from Queer Them All!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514319/3d8ef42e8a862cc1542508d2a4cbf2911c1165fd.png[/img]

[*] Various Bug Fixes. Quality of life improvements, nits picked, and other edges smoothed.
[/list]

We’ll be adding additional languages from[url=https://queer-them-all.itch.io/] Queer Them All![/url] in the coming weeks. As usual, please don’t hesitate to leave us any technical issues you may encounter on our bug reporting form.
Love the game? Leaving a Steam review means the world to us, as well as helps us get the game into the hands of more people! So if you like what you’ve played, please let us know.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.4 is now live!
notes.content:
[h2]/UPDATING…[/h2]

[b]v1.4 Update[/b]

[list]
[*] Addressed Steam Deck resolution issue causing visuals to extend beyond its otherwise capable screen.
[*] Corrected some typos

[/list]

[h2]/ARE YOUR BUGS SQUASHED?[/h2]

If your issues have been fixed, and you love Psychroma, please consider supporting Rocket Adrift with a Steam review! Your words help make our game more visible on Steam to those looking for the kind of experience it offers: you know, those good/bad feels! If you've already written a review, we thank you for your kind words and thoughtful observations.

Thanks to [i]you[/i] for all of your continued support!

notes.title: Support for 20 languages coming to PSYCHROMA!
notes.content:
[h2]/INCOMING…[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514319/3d8ef42e8a862cc1542508d2a4cbf2911c1165fd.png[/img]

Volunteer-based organization Queer Them All has selected Psychroma to be provided with 20 language localizations as part of their celebration of Pride Month! These languages include:

[list]
[*] Catalan
[*] Korean,
[*] German
[*] Greek
[*] Spanish (EU)
[*] Spanish (LATAM)
[*] Hungarian
[*] French (France)
[*] Italian
[*] Dutch
[*] Norwegian
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese (BR)
[*] Portuguese (EU)
[*] Russian
[*] Turkish
[*] Thai
[*] Croatian
[*] Indonesian
[*] Slovak
[/list]

Work is already well underway and these languages will be included in a free update to the game in the near future.

We're so thankful to have been chosen and are very excited that the community thought the stories in Psychroma were worth sharing to more people!

[b]Further reminder: there's just under 24 hours left to take advantage of our launch discount[/b], so if you're interested in any of the above languages, now would be a great time to snag your copy of the game!

notes.title: /v1.3 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]/UPDATING…[/h2]

[list]
[*] Addressed softlock issues when replaying Agatha's Memory 1 - [i]unfortunately those affected will have to start a new game. We're very sorry for the inconvenience[/i].
[*] Addressed player movement lock in Hallway 7F.
[*] Addressed various spelling and grammar details.
[*] Addressed CPU log scaling issue which would cut them off on some devices.
[/list]

We've also managed to straighten out an issue with our repositories affecting installation for desktop linux users.

[h2]/THANK YOU![/h2]

You've made our launch a special one and love reading your reviews! We're so glad you've connected with the characters and their stories.

We have some exciting announcements coming in the near future, including localization options, platforms and more…

We really appreciate your support!
